notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
